label: suspect

unstated.what: Kraken auto-generated notes for custom-asset events must use the custom asset's name inside the existing templates (e.g. 'Swap 1 Gold Bar in Kraken', 'Receive 1 Gold Bar as a result of a Kraken swap', 'Spend 1 Gold Bar as Kraken trading fee', 'Gain 1 Gold Bar from Kraken staking', 'Spend 1 Gold Bar as Kraken staking fee', 'Withdraw 1 Gold Bar from Kraken', 'Spend 1 Gold Bar as Kraken withdrawal fee', 'Deposit 1 Gold Bar to Kraken')

instruction_covers: switching a Kraken history event to a custom asset must not break fetching/displaying Kraken history events
notes: Repo rotkehlchen/history/events/structures/base.py:serialize() already generates the Kraken notes templates via resolve_to_asset_with_symbol().symbol, which raises WrongAssetType for a CustomAsset (verified: CustomAsset is AssetWithNameAndType, not AssetWithSymbol; custom assets are added to globaldb so they resolve, then fail the type check). The adjacent repo helper Asset.symbol_or_name() exists precisely for this (symbol when available, else name) and keeps regular-asset output byte-identical, so grep surfaces the single-convention fix. The instruction never mentions notes wording, so a crash-only fix (identifier, empty notes) would fail; hence suspect, not sound.
